title: SMTO-SKL-0007 — The saved API key for this Skill is empty or unusable
summary: The Parameter Store field this Skill points to is empty, isn't plain text, or is much too long to be a key. SMTO didn't use it, and nothing was sent to the provider with it.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0007 — The saved API key for this Skill is empty or unusable

html:
SMTO-SKL-0007 — The saved API key for this Skill is empty or unusable

GUID: f7d5ee06-b542-4a41-9ab7-c22580eeea3a
Slug: skill-credential-value-invalid
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: skl

What happened

  • The Parameter Store field this Skill points to is empty, isn't plain text, or is much too long to be a key. SMTO didn't use it, and nothing was sent to the provider with it.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Parameter Store from the More options menu and open the entry named in the Skill's Parameter Store key box. The problem is in what that entry holds, not in the Skill's own settings.
  2. Find the field named in the Skill's Credential field pointer box. If it's empty or holds something other than the key, paste the key from your provider there and save the entry. SMTO can only use a field that holds the key itself as a single piece of text.
  3. If the key is actually in a different field, change Credential field pointer in the Skill's settings to that field, then select Save. Pointing to the right field fixes it without editing the stored secret.

What success looks like

  • The Skill's settings save without this message, and Test connection, if offered, shows Connected.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't paste the key into the conversation or the error details; share only the copied details, which leave it out.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The referenced Parameter Store field resolved to a value that is not a string, is empty, or exceeds 16,384 characters, so it cannot be used as a Skill credential.

What this means

  • The resolved credential is not a string, is empty or exceeds 16384 characters. This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • The resolved credential is not a string, is empty or exceeds 16384 characters.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the private field type and size without including its value in diagnostics.

How to fix it

  • The reference's JSON Pointer must resolve to a non-empty string of at most 16,384 characters in the record's value_json (not a number, object, array or null). Edit the referenced field in Parameter Store, or repoint the Skill's reference to the correct string field, without copying the value into configuration, logs or error reports.
  • Edit the referenced secret field in Parameter Store to the bounded nonempty string required by this Skill. Never put the value in public diagnostics.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The referenced field meets the credential contract and remains out of public settings.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
